content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi,

I hope you’re well. Before I sign the agreement, I would like to suggest a few adjustments for clarity and balance:

- The relevant clause currently requires CBC to defend and assume responsibility for any third‑party infringement claim without any monetary limit. This could expose CBC to unlimited costs. I propose adding a liability cap equal to the total fees paid by MediWound under the agreement.
- The termination clause allows MediWound to end the agreement with six months’ notice while the contractor must give twenty‑four months. This creates an imbalance in termination rights. I suggest wording the clause so that either party may terminate the agreement upon providing six (6) months prior written notice to the other party.
- The limitation of liability clause excludes many types of damages but does not set an overall monetary cap, leaving the parties exposed to unlimited liability for other claims. I recommend adding a total aggregate liability cap that does not exceed the total fees paid by the Client to the Contractor under the agreement.

Please let me know if these revisions are acceptable. I look forward to finalizing the agreement.

Thank you,

Best regards
